sections.title: SECTION 1: SELECT THE CORRECT ANSWER. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: Jenny didn't _________ for the meeting today because her car broke down.
questions.explanation: turn up = arrive, appear (姿を現す・出席する) [教科書 Unit 2-C p.25 / PDF]

questions.text: I had to _________ the invitation to the party because I was sick.
questions.explanation: turn down = decline, say no to an offer (断る・辞退する) [教科書 Unit 2-C p.25 / PDF]

questions.text: Don't worry, I'm sure everything will _________ fine in the end.
questions.explanation: turn out = to have a particular result, to be the case (結果として〜になる) [教科書 Unit 2-C p.25 / PDF]

questions.text: The team was losing, but they managed to _________ the game in the second half.
questions.explanation: turn around = for the outcome to be changed for the better (事態を好転させる・逆転させる) [教科書 Unit 2-C p.25 / PDF]

questions.text: Did you _________ your homework to the teacher on time?
questions.explanation: turn in = submit (提出する) [PDF '_turn_ phrasal verbs']

questions.text: What time do you usually _________ at night?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.1: turn in = 1) go to bed (夜、寝床につく・就寝する)

questions.text: Did your last birthday party _________ okay?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.2: turn out = have a particular result (結果として〜になる・うまくいく)

questions.text: Have you ever _________ an offer or a gift?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.3: turn down = decline; say 'no' to something (申し出や贈り物を断る)

questions.text: Do you always _________ your homework on time?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.4: turn in = 2) submit (宿題などを提出する)

questions.text: Do you usually _________ for social events early or late?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.5: turn up = 1) arrive (イベントなどに姿を現す・到着する)

questions.text: Have you ever _________ a difficult situation?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.6: turn around = for the outcome of something to be changed for the better (困難な状況を好転させる)

questions.text: What is something you have lost that _________ in an unexpected place?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.7: turn up = 2) to appear after being lost (なくした物がひょっこり出てくる・見つかる)

questions.text: Does smoking _________ you _________?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.8: turn (someone) off = make you less interested in something or someone (興味を失わせる・嫌悪感を抱かせる)

questions.text: Our business didn't do well, but if we make a better plan, I think we can _________ next year.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.9-1: turn it around = 業績や事態を好転させる

questions.text: We went to the park on Saturday, but no one was there. It _________ that my schedule was wrong.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.9-2: It turned out that ~ (〜ということが判明した・結果として〜だった)

questions.text: I have to _________ your delicious cake because I have gained too much weight this year!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.9-3: turn down = 断る・遠慮する

questions.text: His friends cut the cord, and he took off! It _________ his plan worked!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.27) Ex.5-3: It turned out (that) his plan worked! (彼の計画がうまくいったと判明した)

questions.text: Which phrasal verb means both 'to go to bed' and 'to submit'?
questions.explanation: PDF Definition: turn in = 1) go to bed, 2) submit

questions.text: Which phrasal verb means 'to make you less interested in something or someone'?
questions.explanation: PDF Definition: turn off = make you less interested in something or someone

questions.text: He has a bad grade in math, but if he studies harder, he can _________.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Expressions: turn it around = 状況を好転させる・挽回する
